description: Open-source computer-use harness for OpenAI-compatible vision models: an agent loop (legato.Harness), desktops on this computer, a Docker container, any Linux sandbox or E2B (legato.local, legato.attach, --sandbox), an MCP server for coding agents, and RL rollouts. PyPI package legatolabs, import legato.
rules: The PyPI package is legatolabs and the import is `import legato`; there is no `pip install legato`.
Install the extra for the desktop you use: legatolabs[local] for this computer, legatolabs[e2b] for E2B, legatolabs[mcp] for the MCP server; --sandbox docker needs only Docker.
To give a coding agent a desktop, prefer `legato mcp --sandbox docker`: the agent then cannot touch the user's own screen.
Read model keys from the environment (for example OPENROUTER_API_KEY and E2B_API_KEY); a local model server needs no key.
Set coords= explicitly for a model you have not checked: Claude models use pixels, other models a 0-1000 grid (coords="norm1000").
If setup fails, run `legato doctor --json` to see which sandboxes, extras and keys are ready.
